why: Controls below this project's own 28px coarse-pointer floor, recorded so the count cannot grow while the existing set is triaged. Not an allowance: every one of these is a real shortfall. Resizing them changes how the plugin feels and how nearly every capture looks, which is an operator decision rather than a repair one pass should make silently.
smallest: db-file-tag-remove at 10x14, db-multi-select-remove at 14x14, db-table-row-drag-handle at 16x16
note: db-toggle-switch measures 34x18 under a coarse pointer here, which is a second independent contradiction of roadmap 7.1's claim that the switch reaches 34x28.
lastTriage: 215 -> 279 on 2026-09-03, and the ratchet is raised, not lowered: the timeline/Gantt port (037) added four scale-scenario screenshots (day, month, quarter, year) alongside the existing week scenario, so 64 controls that were already below floor at week scale — db-timeline-nav-button (20x20/60x20), db-timeline-group-toggle (18x18), db-timeline-event (20px tall), db-timeline-create-button (20px tall), db-timeline-scale-menu (20px tall, 52-74px wide depending on the active scale's label) — are now also measured at the other four scales, 16 per scenario for each of the five classes. None of the five is a new class; all of them already sat inside the 215 recorded here before this packet, just counted once. db-timeline-link-dot, which briefly carried a touch-targets exemption for its ::before hit box, is no longer one of the five: its interactive element is now sized to the 28px floor directly, so a bounding-box measurement finds it fine without an exemption. Resizing the remaining timeline chrome is the same operator-scale call the `why` field describes and is not this packet's fix. 228 -> 215 on 2026-09-02, and the ratchet is lowered because the shortfall it recorded was repaired. The invalid-events modal's twelve controls were the reason 224 became 228: `db-invalid-event-row-fix` declared `height: 24px` and the modal's datetime inputs measured 19px tall, and none of them appeared in the coarse-pointer raise list beside their siblings. They are in it now, and nine controls that measured under the floor in that fixture measure 0 under it. Thirteen fewer in total, measured twice at 215 before this number was written. A ratchet that is not lowered when the defect is fixed stops recording anything. Previously, 224 -> 228 on 2026-09-02, recording those twelve rather than resizing them; and 286 -> 224 on 2026-09-01, when `db-list-row-open` (36) and `db-source-rule-icon-button` (26) were raised under coarse pointer. The rest of the 215 are untouched and still await the operator decision the `why` describes.
